THIRD-PARTY NOTICES (test fixture of apps/site, not the real notices)

The site tests publish this file as https://smurg.ai/third-party-notices.txt, so that they do not depend on the
Node.js distribution that runs them. A deploy publishes the release's THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt instead
(apps/site/scripts/site.ts, readNotices).
